issues.reason: "everything" is an explicit universal over the seen objects, and the two-quantifier rule states that universals become rule premises (the forall-forall shape with one premise per universal and a Skolem-function event of both bindings), so collapsing it into the bare constant `thing` drops the stated quantification and the QuantifierPhrase companion an explicit quantifier word requires.

gaps_confirmed: a manner-expressing PP ("in black and white"): Manner is specified as taking an adverb and the preposition-named oblique is specified for aboutness/direction PPs, so an "in <manner>" PP has no clear routing
new_gaps: pronominal universals ("everything", "everyone"): the kind to range over (`thing` / `person`) and the string to record in the QuantifierPhrase companion ("every" vs the surface "everything") are unspecified
repair_summary: Rewrote the rule in the forall-forall shape — added the second universal premise (Member $y thing), made the event the Skolem function (sk_see $x $y), and bound (Stimulus (sk_see $x $y) $y); added the (QuantifierPhrase thing see "every") companion for the explicit quantifier.
notes: Everything else is untouched: the 0.9/0.9 generic TV, the absent status atom, the Experiencer/Stimulus assignment, and the (In … black_and_white) oblique, which is only a gap claim.
